SEN.note: Document covers state payments to people, not public procurement.
No central bank role is stated; the actor is the Treasury directorate.
No consumer-protection rule or redress body is stated.

facts.fact: The Treasury directorate (DGCPT) launched SenTrésor on 2 June 2025, a digital platform to pay state expenditure including salaries, allowances, pensions, scholarships and social aid, with instant receipt of payment.
The DGCPT says SenTrésor pays salaries and allowances, pensions, scholarships and social aid, and names village chiefs, students and salaried staff as beneficiaries.

SEN.note: No survey share of adults with an account is stated.
Mobile money operators are named only as partners; no retail service is described.
Document covers payments by the state, not payments to it.
